These four experiments use the installed **rSPDE BRASIL coefficients** and
consistent FEM matrix solvers. Knit displays saved results without running
an experiment. The current numerical parameters are recorded in each notebook.

[Theory and all implementation functions](brasilfunc.html) ·
[Combined convergence figure](about.html#rational-and-spatial-convergence)

## Smooth data

- [Convergence in space](cov_in_h_mat.html): order eight, smooth finite-mode data.
- [Convergence in time](conv_in_tau_mat.html): order eight, fixed spatial mesh.
- [Isolated convergence in rational order](conv_in_m_isolated.html): orders 2–8,
  compared with exact-discrete backward Euler on the same FEM matrices.

## Rough data

- [Convergence in space with a sampled reference](cov_in_h_rough_as_in_mat.html):
  fixed infinite L2 forcing, with a fixed 16-mode continuum reference evaluated
  on a fine space-time mesh, following the smooth matrix workflow.
